atomic_cutover: Replace four #4074 imports and the #4076 composition-test companion with workflow-owned native DTOs and a narrow native source facade on the same bound store. Exactly 36 consumed operations plus the original-error conflict classifier; no unused source operation or widened selector. Parent announcements, polls, targets/options, all declaration inputs, metadata and nullable fields remain complete. Native codecs preserve nil/empty/nil-entry collections, context and selectors, partial owner results and write mutations even on errors; owner error identity wins. Published conflicts are classified by the actual owner over its original sentinel, without a new error alias or imported foreign model. Canonical content/record encoders and their format/version constants move once into the existing owned application; canonical bytes are recomputed from current complete values, never cached or copied algorithms. Pure policy suites move with the implementation; the boundary probe uses immutable reference bytes captured from the prior implementation. The final parentstore-to-models/users key is removed in the same PR. Domain stores now project native public values directly, with their existing payload codec and current-field kind derivation. Retired ORM-shaped DTOs, four repository aliases and redundant retained-record codecs are deleted. Consumer-owned staff-person/account and guardian-recipient ports receive the same owner query results through root callbacks, preserving context, IDs, missing/nil states, partial errors, school filters, order and deduplication. Existing contract assertions remain in their calling suite; primitive fixture constructors and typed selection helpers use the existing root test seam without a foreign import grant. Database timestamp callbacks execute at the original point after Create/ReplaceTargets. Published/conflict errors move their original initializer text once into the actual owner and keep native classification. Total keys 119 -> 113 on the original source baseline, now 104 after the independent development reductions; #4074 5 -> 0, #4076 14 -> 13. Own policy diff zero, integrated rules842/epoch72/composition1657 unchanged; Communication composition1481 -> 1480, People vocabulary110 -> 106 and integrated compose total34551 -> 34546; service file-size budget1178 -> 1177. No new grant, Go type alias, classification, exception, graph field or increased budget. Routes, response projections, goldens, IoT, SQL, relationship permissions, RLS, clocks, sessions and wrong-portal rejection unchanged.
